summary: The pending authentication debounce is now cancellable, and the focused regression test covers the empty-token transition.

evidence: static/chat.js:50-64 adds cancel support to the debounce helper, and static/chat.js:597-605 cancels scheduleAuthCheck before starting the empty-token local-auth probe.

tests/chat-auth-debounce.test.ts:146-160 creates a pending auth debounce, clears the token, verifies the timer is canceled, and asserts local authentication remains successful rather than reporting Missing token.
